run_findings.mcp_tasks_current_surface: REFINED: current io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension exposes tasks/get, tasks/update, tasks/cancel and explicitly no tasks/list. The legacy 2025-11-25 experimental Tasks surface did have listing; version qualification is mandatory.
run_findings.mcp_unknown_handle_window: STILL_OPEN_BY_STOCK_EXTENSION: CreateTaskResult cannot be returned before durable creation, but if that response is lost before client records the server-generated taskId, current standard Tasks has no enumeration/rediscovery method and the Task shape has no original-operation identity.
run_findings.csharp_v2_task_store: EXACT_VERSION_DISAMBIGUATION: current v2 IMcpTaskStore.CreateTaskAsync accepts CancellationToken only; it does not receive RequestId/original request. Non-versioned/v1 experimental docs with CreateTaskAsync(...RequestId, JsonRpcRequest...) and ListTasksAsync are a different contract.
run_findings.mcp_preflight_create_or_get: SOURCE_EQUIVALENT_PROVED_PATTERN: side-effect-free MRTR preflight mints integrity-bound op_id bound to method/args/principal; client persists requestState; later round atomically create-or-get(op_id,intent). Lost create response plus fresh JSON-RPC id returns same task/effect. Fixture batch PASS 7/7.
run_findings.mcp_minimal_custom_surface: NARROWED: current C# v2 WithTasks eagerly creates the task before the inner tool handler, and IMcpTaskStore cannot see original request identity. Therefore a safe preflight fence needs a request-aware seam before/equivalent to task creation or a custom alternate-handler/tasks integration, not merely a custom task store.
run_findings.openhands_fenced_commit_marker: SOURCE_EQUIVALENT_PROVED_RECOVERY_MODEL: generation + expected-old-HEAD + event id/hash marker before append lets recovery finish only exact intended commits, clear applied markers idempotently, and refuse implicit unique-orphan repair. Fixture batch PASS 7/7; not yet an upstream patch/test.
